page.layout: One scanned page with no printed text: a library stamp at the upper left, a pencilled shelf mark on the left and below it, a dark binding edge at the left, and a digitiser's credit at the lower right. None of these is transcribed.
page.notes: No printed text on this scan. The left-hand stamp reads "ATIONALE" with the numbers "13", "22 G" and "22"; this is a library stamp and is left out. The handwritten marks ("3", "6", and strokes) are pencilled shelf marks and are left out. The lower-right credit is the digitiser's banner and is left out.
